value.description: Value to be used directly in the order string in the evaluate call of {@link UiSdlCategoricalLineBarChart}.

title:
A specification used to directly specify a custom order string for {@link UiSdlCategoricalLineBarChart}.
This is used when the user wants to order items based on the sum/difference of multiple fields.
For example, if a user wants to sort the items on the chart based on the difference of 2 fields, `X` and `Y`,
the `value` field of this type is set to `X - Y`, and the sortOrder field is set to `descending`.
name: UiSdlCategoricalLineBarChartDataSpecOrderSetting
